payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Create a brutalist design with raw, unpolished, stark aesthetic. Use pure primary colors (red, blue, yellow), black & white, no smooth transitions (instant), sharp corners, bold large typography, visible grid lines, default system fonts, intentional 'broken' design elements.
payload.best_for: Design portfolios, artistic projects, counter-culture brands, editorial/media sites, tech blogs
payload.css_technical_keywords: border-radius: 0px, transition: none or 0s, font-family: system-ui or monospace, font-weight: 700+, border: visible 2-4px, colors: #FF0000, #0000FF, #FFFF00, #000000, #FFFFFF
payload.do_not_use_for: Corporate environments, conservative industries, critical accessibility, customer-facing professional
payload.effects_and_animation: No smooth transitions (instant), sharp corners (0px), bold typography (700+), visible grid, large blocks
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ No border-radius (0px), ☐ No transitions (instant), ☐ Bold typography (700+), ☐ Pure primary colors used, ☐ Visible grid/borders, ☐ Asymmetric layout intentional
payload.keywords: Raw, unpolished, stark, high contrast, plain text, default fonts, visible borders, asymmetric, anti-design
payload.primary_colors: Primary: Red #FF0000, Blue #0000FF, Yellow #FFFF00, Black #000000, White #FFFFFF
payload.secondary_colors: Limited: Neon Green #00FF00, Hot Pink #FF00FF, minimal secondary
